ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 34
   C. 17
   D. 22

2. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

3. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 73

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

7. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 4

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

9. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 21
   C. 42
   D. 90

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

12. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 25

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

14. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x > 5

15. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 1
   C. 21
   D. 20

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

17. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 24.5
   C. 49
   D. 8

18. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

19. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 12

20. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 15

21. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

22. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

23. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

24. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

25. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

26. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

27. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

28. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

29. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 15
   D. 1

30. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40
